findings.title: Exception class removed
findings.subject: exceptions.py::CallableRuntimeError
findings.detail: CallableRuntimeError no longer exists in 2.0.0. An `except CallableRuntimeError:` fails at import -- but a handler that caught it was catching a real failure mode, and whatever now replaces it is uncaught until the handler is rewritten. On replay this surfaces where a checkpointed failure is re-raised.
